External Resources

Free, reputable sites for extra reading practice. These open outside the portal.

  • Opens outside the portal

    CommonLit

    A large free library of reading passages with comprehension questions, organized by reading level. Assigned in Weeks 1 and 3 of this course.

    Visit site ↗
  • Opens outside the portal

    News in Levels

    Current news stories rewritten at several reading levels, useful for building reading stamina on real-world material.

    Visit site ↗
  • Opens outside the portal

    Brooklyn Public Library

    Free library card, computer access, and adult literacy programs across Brooklyn.

    Visit site ↗
  • Opens outside the portal

    CUNY Adult Literacy and HSE Program

    Information on CUNY adult literacy, HSE, and college transition programs.

    Visit site ↗

Materials you get in class, not here

Some of the materials named in your syllabus are copyrighted print publications. The Reading Lab does not host them, and that is deliberate rather than an oversight.

  • Scoreboost for TABE, Reading Level M

    Copyrighted workbook distributed in class. Homework page ranges appear in the course roadmap.

  • TABE Mastery Reading, Level M

    Copyrighted student book distributed in class. Homework page ranges appear in the course roadmap.

  • Pretest and TABE practice tests

    Assessment materials administered by your instructor under program conditions.

  • Answer keys and the Teacher's Manual

    Instructor-only materials. These are never published to students in any format.

Where graded work goes

Nothing you do in the Reading Lab is graded or recorded. Practice here as often as you want, then submit official work in Brightspace. Assignments, submissions, attendance, announcements, and grades are all in Brightspace.
